title: On subgroups of Brin-Thompson groups $nV$
summary: We prove that the Brin-Thompson group $nV$ is torsion locally finite for $ n \geq 1$ which is known only when $n = 1$, and $nV$ contains continuum many copies of the additive group of the rationals $\mathbb{Q}$ for $n \geq 2$ which is known to be false for the $n = 1$ case.
